design.optIn: Empty/off by default; only explicit native set(enabled=true) creates a reservation. Existing opted-in configuration resumes without importing CHZZK reservations. Star, search, watching, privacy, minimize and platform switching never opt in or disable a reservation.
design.storage: Versioned bounded atomic configuration; expected revision rejects stale writes, corrupt config is preserved and blocks automatic starts. Durable runId/broadcastKey/generation intent precedes start; same broadcast is suppressed once started/stopped so crashes or failures cannot silently create duplicate captures. User off/on explicitly resets suppression; a confirmed new broadcast becomes eligible. Runtime fault or failed off-write still disables the matching enabled owner in memory, increments revision/generation, and reports non-persistence plus possible re-enable after restart; it never pretends durable off succeeded.
design.observations: Fresh anonymous SOOP station metadata, stable positive broad_no and restricted flag. Unknown/errors do not mean offline. Two consecutive explicit offline observations end an owned automatic recording. At most two bounded12s metadata workers, per-channel30s reservation plus round-robin and error backoff; metadata only, no recurring avatar download. Preparation and start failures survive healthy polls/restart and clear only after actual recording begins.
design.ownership: Manual versus Scheduled(scheduleId,runId,broadcastKey,generation). A scheduled-only receiver has no fake viewer lease. Opening a viewer attaches to the same canonical channel receiver. Auto-off only stops the exact scheduled owner, never a manual replacement or another viewer. Stops finalize verified files through the existing media pipeline; failures preserve originals.
design.admission: Four shared live sessions separate from two VOD workers. All new receiver starts register under existing quit/update gate; no network/wait while holding the gate. Capacity errors remain visible and retry on bounded later observation. Idle enabled reservations are not active work; in-flight start/drain is. Shutdown closes admission before workers drain; late observations cannot restart. Worker registration and shutdown are serialized under the core lock; RAII counts include not-yet-entered spawned workers and panic exits. After shutdown, active_ids includes actual metadata-worker drain until all possible configuration writers exit; reset must not create its marker before this is empty. Bounded wait failure does not mean successful drain.
design.startup: Construct lightweight service only; load config and poll on background worker. Heavy media initialization only after a fresh opted-in live observation. No app auto-run settings or PC wake changes.
design.ui: Root supplies centered fixed-size circle beside star with stable row order and loading slot, short 예약 꺼짐/녹화 예약 됨/녹화 준비/녹화 중/마무리 중/자리 대기 states. Favorites and enabled reservations are unioned; star changes favorites only. No manual status button or extra automatic-recording tab.
